Core: KERNEL (process management, memory management, file system, device drivers)
SYSTEM CALLS: the programmatic interface between a process and the kernel (e.g. fork, read).
SYSTEM PROGRAMS (utilities): executable programs shipped with the OS that USE system calls to
provide user-facing functionality (e.g. ls, cp, gcc, top). They run in user mode, not kernel mode.
